theme_and_archetype.vibe: Optimistic, light, tactile, romantic, and dreamy.
theme_and_archetype.reasoning: A couples' long-distance app should feel intimate, warm, and playful. Pure clinical dark tech themes or standard white/blue SaaS themes kill the romance. Pastels mixed with high-contrast text and glassmorphism provide a modern, emotional connection.

typography.rules: Avoid default sans-serifs like Inter. Use 'Outfit' for a modern, rounded, tech-friendly but dreamy display font, and 'Nunito' for highly readable, soft body text.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-800

layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, and p-12 inside cards and containers to let content breathe and feel less cluttered.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-3xl for main containers, rounded-2xl for inner cards, rounded-full for buttons.

grids.dashboard: Bento 'Tetris' Grid. Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6. Mix spans to create asymmetry.
grids.watch_room: Control Room Grid. The video player takes up 75% of the screen width on desktop (col-span-9), while the chat/partner video sidebar takes up 25% (col-span-3).

component_strategies.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary buttons use deep indigo (#1E1B4B) text-white for high contrast against pastels. Hover state adds shadow and slight lift (-translate-y-0.5).
component_strategies.inputs: Shadcn inputs customized with rounded-xl, bg-white/50 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-lavender-400 border-slate-200.
component_strategies.chat_bubbles: Partner: bg-white text-slate-800 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm. You: bg-[#1E1B4B] text-white rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm. Generous padding p-4.
component_strategies.partner_video_pip: Floating circular or soft-rectangle (rounded-3xl) picture-in-picture overlay in the corner of the watch room. 1px solid white/20 border, heavy backdrop blur.
component_strategies.reactions: Floating emoji buttons in the chat input area. When clicked, emojis should animate floating up the screen (using Framer Motion).

motion_and_interaction.transitions: All interactive elements must use smooth transitions (e.g., transition-all duration-300 ease-out).
motion_and_interaction.page_load: Fade-in with a slight upward translation (y: 10 -> 0) using framer-motion.
motion_and_interaction.watch_room_sync: Visual ripple effect around the play/pause button when a sync signal is received from the partner.

icons_and_assets.style: Use stroke-width 2, round edges. Keep them consistent.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do not use Inter or any generic sans-serif for headings. Always import and apply 'Outfit' for headings and 'Nunito' for body.
2. All cards and overlays MUST use the defined Crystal Glassmorphism surface: bg-white/60, backdrop-blur-2xl, border-white/40.
3. Use the 'Bento Tetris' pattern for the dashboard: irregular, engaging grid spans, heavily padded, leaving intentional empty cells if needed.
4. For the Watch Room, switch the background to dark mode (#0F172A) to simulate 'lights out' for movie watching, but retain glassmorphism on the chat/video sidebar (bg-white/10).
5. Every button, input, or toggle MUST have a focus state with high contrast (e.g. ring-2 ring-indigo-900).
6. Do not use Shadcn components without stripping their default rigid Vercel-like borders/shadows and applying our soft, pastel, rounded-2xl styles.
7. Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements using kebab-case and role-based naming.
8. Never use placeholder images. Rely solely on the media object URLs provided.
